The N2O system currently in place for the brig's cells is redundant, now
that we have our new atmospheric system in place for the station...

We should get rid of the N2O cannisters and the piping in the maintenance
hallway connected to forensics, and instead connect the brig cells
individually to the station's atmos piping.

Then, inside the brig (but not in the cells) place an airflow control (to
extract/pass gasses) for each cell, so you can simply extract N2O from the
station's atmospheric circulation (which can be put in there manually for
this purpose during a round). Make the airflow vents there not need any
kind of atmosheric ID to access, so anyone who has access to the brig in
the first place can simply modify the air going in and out of the cells.

Or we could just leave it like it is, you don't want to kill the prisoners every
round do you?
